issue_context.title: DEPR: values casting dt64tz, Interval, Period
issue_context.body:
ATM series.values drops the tz from dt64tz, converts interval to object, converts period to object, but preserves other EAs.  We have kept this weird behavior for backward compatibility, should eventually just bite the bullet and deprecate these weird behaviors, just match `_values`

I think this would close #55128

review_comments: The "user" is not using `.values` here, they should not see a warning (at least in regards to using `.values`). Will the behavior here actually change for a user?
If the data is tz-agnostic, then there will be no behavior change. So users should not see a warning.
How can I see if the data is tz-agnostic?
Can you make this warning specific to period / interval. In other words, if they have period data, they should just see the message for period.
